snippet.title: [Launch Trailer] Souls of White Star Early Access is finally available!
snippet.description:
This is a space-themed turn-based strategy game that cleverly combines card and tactical gameplay. You can also experience rich game content. The game is only $13.49 in the first week!

The game now supports the Workshop! Join us and experience brand-new content from other parallel universes. If you encounter any bugs in the universe, please feel free to urge us to fix them. 

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/FKTGnyrYwf
